core_obligations: Record flatness and Noetherianity of the completion map (proof lines 13055-13058).
Reduce to the local criterion for property P at a maximal ideal of the completion lying over a maximal ideal of the ring (proof lines 13059-13065).
Identify the two residue fields and the two maximal ideals, and conclude that the localised map induces an isomorphism on completions (proof lines 13066-13074).
Note faithful flatness of the next completion map (proof lines 13075-13079).
Apply condition (D) to the chain of ring maps and conclude using that the ring is a P-ring (proof lines 13080-13091).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to a maximal ideal of the completion (proof lines 13059-13065).
Compare the local rings and their completions (proof lines 13066-13079).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the fibres of the completion of a P-ring with respect to an ideal have property P. The proof verifies the local criterion for property P: the completion map is flat and the completion is Noetherian, so it remains to treat a maximal ideal of the completion lying over a maximal ideal of the ring, where the two local rings are shown to have a flat local map identifying residue fields and with equal maximal ideals, hence an isomorphism on completions. Faithful flatness of the completion of the localised completion then lets the author apply the permanence condition (D) to the chain of two ring maps, the outer one being the completion of a P-ring and therefore having the required property on its fibres.
